newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 22.635 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 22.635 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day TIIE interbank interest rate fell by 8 basis points to 22.6350 percent on Wednesday, from 22.7150 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP rose 48.88 basis points to 22.6132 percent on Wednesday from 22.1244 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE meanwhile rose 22 basis points to 22.5850 percent on Wednesday from 22.3650 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
